concepts.def: Every two point masses attract with force F = Gm₁m₂/r².
Force per unit mass at a point: g = F/m = GM/r², measured in N kg⁻¹.
Work done per unit mass to bring a mass from infinity: V = −GM/r, measured in J kg⁻¹.
Energy of a mass in a field: E_p = −GMm/r.
An equatorial orbit with period 24 hours so the satellite remains above a fixed point on Earth.
Minimum speed needed to escape a gravitational field, v = √(2GM/r).
